name: Shizuku Tatewaki
source:
A retired Kunoichi raised and trained in the East who now lives a quiet life in Ishgalia with her husband Ricardo and adopted son Ruf (ルフ). She is forced back into active service when her master Yuukage comes to Ishgalia demanding assistance with a certain task.

She is very self-conscious of her appearance and dislikes her Kunoichi outfit for its lack of modesty. Her lack of sexual contact with her husband leads to pent-up sexual frustration.

[Spoiler] She is uncomfortable with slugs, which is problematic for her in the caverns below Ishgalia. [/Spoiler]
